stories.title: El Rey, ante Macron y Sánchez, sobre Ceuta: «La intrusión masiva violando una frontera es inaceptable»

en.title: The King, before Macron and Sánchez, on Ceuta: "Massive intrusion violating a border is unacceptable"
en.summary: King Felipe VI addressed the Ceuta crisis caused by the massive entry of thousands of people two months earlier during a gala dinner at the Royal Palace with French President Macron and Spanish Prime Minister Sánchez, calling the intrusion unacceptable and requesting European solidarity.

stories.title: Felipe VI exige ante Macron y Sánchez eficacia en la defensa de la frontera de Ceuta: "No podemos afrontar solos una responsabilidad de todos"

en.title: Felipe VI demands before Macron and Sánchez effective defense of Ceuta's border: "We cannot face alone a responsibility of all"
en.summary: King Felipe VI demanded more effective defense of Ceuta's border before Macron and Sánchez, stating that massive people intrusion is unacceptable and that responsibility cannot fall solely on Spain.

stories.title: La Reina Letizia deslumbra con la tiara floral y un vestido azul cielo en la cena de gala en honor a Macron

en.title: Queen Letizia shines with floral tiara and light blue dress at gala dinner in honor of Macron
en.summary: Queen Letizia was the focal point of the gala dinner at the Royal Palace honoring French President Macron, wearing an elegant light blue Carolina Herrera dress and a floral tiara.

stories.title: El Rey exige ante Macron más apoyo de la UE en Ceuta: “Es una responsabilidad de todos”

en.title: The King demands more EU support from Macron on Ceuta: "It is a responsibility of all"
en.summary: During the gala dinner at the Royal Palace, King Felipe VI demanded greater EU support for Ceuta, calling the massive intrusion of tens of thousands of people unacceptable due to its security and public order challenges.

stories.title: El Senado deroga el Tratado de Amistad con Francia con el voto en contra del PP

en.title: Senate repeals Friendship Treaty with France with PP voting against
en.summary: Spain's Senate voted to reject a 2023 Friendship and Cooperation Treaty with France that had been signed by presidents Pedro Sánchez and Emmanuel Macron. The Popular Party's Senate majority opposed the agreement, which would have granted France unprecedented brotherhood status including participation in Spain's Council of Ministers.

stories.title: El PP bloquea de nuevo el tratado de amistad Francia-España que avaló el Constitucional

en.title: PP blocks France-Spain friendship treaty again despite Constitutional Court approval
en.summary: Spain's Congress and Senate disagreed on approving a friendship treaty with France that the Constitutional Court had validated. A mixed commission will now attempt to resolve the legislative chambers' conflicting positions.

stories.title: El Senado tumba el Tratado de Amistad con Francia en plena visita de Macron a España

en.title: Senate rejects Friendship Treaty with France during Macron's visit to Spain
en.summary: Spain's Senate, with the PP's absolute majority, voted against the Friendship Treaty with France while President Macron was being hosted at a state dinner by Spanish royalty at the Royal Palace.

stories.title: El Senado asesta una derrota al Gobierno y tumba el Tratado de Amistad con Francia

en.title: Senate defeats Government and rejects Friendship Treaty with France
en.summary: The Senate rejected the Friendship Treaty with France, causing the initiative to lapse. The Government will need to restart parliamentary procedures to obtain approval from both chambers of Congress.

stories.title: El Rey habla ante Macron sobre Ceuta: “No podemos afrontar solos una responsabilidad que es de todos”

en.title: The King speaks to Macron about Ceuta: "We cannot face alone a responsibility that belongs to everyone"
en.summary: Spain's King Felipe VI appealed to Brussels for responsibility in managing the crisis in the autonomous city of Ceuta, describing the situation as unacceptable.

stories.title: Muere a los 92 años Gonzalo Suárez, el hombre que no se cansó de ser nuevo

en.title: Gonzalo Suárez, the man who never tired of being new, dies at 92
en.summary: Spanish filmmaker, writer, and journalist Gonzalo Suárez has died. He was known for films including Remando al viento, which won a Goya Award for best direction.

stories.title: Muere el cineasta Gonzalo Suárez a los 92 años

en.title: Filmmaker Gonzalo Suárez dies at 92
en.summary: Spanish screenwriter and film director Gonzalo Suárez has passed away. He received a Goya Award for best direction for the film Remando al viento.

stories.title: Muere Gonzalo Suárez, referente del cine y la literatura españoles, a los 92 años

en.title: Gonzalo Suárez, Spanish cinema and literature reference, dies at 92
en.summary: Gonzalo Suárez, a prominent Spanish filmmaker and writer known for films including 'Remando al viento' and 'Ditirambo', has died at age 92. He was also an accomplished sports journalist and received the Goya de Honor award in February.

stories.title: Trump reúne a los líderes de la IA para apostar por la autorregulación del sector

en.title: Trump brings together AI leaders to promote industry self-regulation
en.summary: The U.S. president hosted major executives from OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, and Nvidia at the White House to discuss artificial intelligence sector self-regulation.

stories.title: El Ibex pierde los 19.600 puntos pendiente de Irán y la inflación

en.title: Ibex loses 19,600 points pending Iran and inflation developments
en.summary: Oil price pressure and debt interest concerns weigh on markets awaiting macroeconomic data, with the Ibex seeking stabilization following previous declines.

stories.title: Todo lo que no tapan los 'decretos Maricarmen'

en.title: Everything the 'Maricarmen decrees' don't cover
en.summary: The government's emphatic response to the rental housing crisis fails to conceal internal divisions and administrative irregularities within the administration.

stories.title: Simón reorganiza la cúpula de Indra con la salida de cinco altos directivos

en.title: Simón reorganizes Indra's leadership with departure of five senior executives
en.summary: Five high-ranking officials—Manuel Ausaverri, Manuel Escalante, Antonio Mora, Juan Pedro Rodríguez, and Miguel Ángel Panduro—have left their positions at the Spanish technology and defense company Indra.

stories.title: El presidente de Vall Companys invierte en OK Mobility

en.title: President of Vall Companys invests in OK Mobility
en.summary: Businessman Josep Vall Esquerda from Lleida invests ten million euros in the car purchase and rental platform OK Mobility, acquiring at least a 5% stake.
